Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer relied on a DuckDuckGo/Wikipedia snippet stating Mathilde Sophie died in Regensburg without opening and verifying the actual source, despite conflicting earlier indications of Obermais, Meran. This over-reliance on search snippets (and repeated similar searches) violated the Planner’s instruction to corroborate using authoritative sources and led to propagating an incorrect death place instead of resolving the discrepancy.
